description: A sorted set three levels deep, in later transactions that put keys it already has. That writes nothing below its header, so the branches over an unchanged leaf aren't copied. Around them are keys that do change the tree, a freeze, and a frozen cursor, and in a sorted map the same thing copies the leaf and the branches. Written by src/longscripts.zig.
